_comment: Schema: { file, purpose, readWhen }. Integration specs describe concrete third-party SDK and API implementations. Each spec includes: SDK version pinned, authentication method, error-to-internal-code mapping, rate limit notes, and a working code example in the service layer. Always check Docs/integration-specs/references/ for lookup catalogs before writing SDK calls. Adding a new integration requires a spec here before any service code is written.
purpose: Neon Postgres + Drizzle: the two drivers (WebSocket Pool for transactions, HTTP for reads), schema and migration workflow, numeric handling, and Postgres error-code mapping.
readWhen: Creating lib/db, writing any query or migration, choosing a driver, or handling a database error.

purpose: Clerk auth: Discord + Google only, middleware protection, lazy user/account provisioning with idempotent signup grant, and admin checks against Postgres.
readWhen: Implementing sign-in, protecting a route or Server Action, provisioning users, or checking admin rights.
